appliesTo: list and lookup endpoints in scope

checks.name: walk sequential ids as a normal user
checks.expect: only the user's own or shared records; the response does not reveal whether other ids exist (same status for 'not yours' and 'missing', or documented otherwise)

checks.name: registration / login / password-reset messages for existing vs unknown emails
page size / limit parameters set very high
burst of 100 requests in a few seconds to login and list endpoints
checks.expect: rate limited (429) where the docs require it; otherwise reported as a recommendation, not a failure, in dev

pass: No bulk access to other users' data and no way to learn which accounts exist.
fail: Other users' records reachable by walking ids, or account existence revealed.
fix: Scope every query to the caller, use identical errors for 'missing' and 'forbidden' where appropriate, cap page sizes, add rate limiting to auth and list endpoints.
